thread:
sam-ml: Heads-up — proposing we onboard Emerald-RLHF-7B for an internal pilot + partner trials. Need a quick legal/security checklist before we start quant and perf runs. We have third-party base weights + RLHF finetune; training manifests mention scraped web corpora. Any immediate blockers?

rebecca-legal: Can you attach the model card + the exact license text and a link to the weights? If license != Apache/MIT we need a review. Also confirm whether weights are derived from any proprietary checkpoints.

sam-ml: Model card (cached): https://hugging.example/emerald-rlhf-7b. License header in repo says: "CC-BY-NC-4.0". Weights provenance note: base was 'emerald-base-7b' (public), RLHF done by a third-party org. I can paste the checksum and a short manifest in a follow-up.

rebecca-legal: CC-BY-NC = non-commercial. That blocks hosted, customer-facing API usage. Internal evals are okay with controls. We need the full license file, proof of authorship for the RLHF contributor, and a high-level training-data provenance statement (esp. whether any licensed proprietary sources were used).

maya: From eng: ran a quick quant smoke. 4-bit q4_0 gives ~2.8x throughput but we saw degradation on long-form summarization (hallucinations). Plan to run: MMLU, HellaSwag, TruthfulQA, SummEval + some custom prompt-sensitivity tests. Need legal signoff before any public demo.

joe-ops: Note on Dedicated vs Hosted: NC license may be acceptable for customers running the model in their infra (private deploy), but we can't expose it on our hosted endpoints. Also KMS + artifact provenance required if customers send data to the model.

rebecca-legal: Exactly. If you want hosted access we either need a commercial license or explicit upstream permission. Also run an export-control self-check (no embargoed-country restrictions).

lex-security-bot: FYI — compliance checklist: https://internal/docs/compliance/model-gate. Required artifacts: license file, weights checksum, training-data provenance, PII scan report, export control attestation, and an attribution plan.

sam-ml: I will run a PII scan over the manifests and attach checksums. Quick question: @rebecca-legal, can we get a sandbox approval for non-prod quant experiments while we attempt to relicense?

rebecca-legal: We can do a timeboxed sandbox approval with conditions: (1) non-prod only, (2) no customer data or partner demos, (3) full audit logging, (4) 30-day approval window. Send the eval script + expected outputs and we'll draft the sandbox approval.

maya: Eval script (draft):
```bash
python eval.py --model emerald-rlhf-7b --tasks mmlu,hellaswag,truthfulqa,summ_eval --batch 8 --seed 42
```
Resource estimate: accuracy suite ~4xA100 for 24h, quant smoke ~1xA100 for 2h.

jordan-product: Quick priority check — product is asking for a partner-only hosted beta in ~6 weeks. Legal constraints look like a blocker. If relicensing fails, can we offer partner-only Dedicated deployments instead?

sam-ml: Partner-only Dedicated seems feasible (VPC + NDA). @joe-ops, can you estimate time to onboard model to Dedicated packaging + KMS integration once we have contract + artifact?

joe-ops: Once we have signed contract and canonical artifact: ~2 weeks for VPC packaging + KMS integration + smoke tests. Need the containerized model, license confirmation, and deployment manifest.

rebecca-legal: Next steps for legal: 1) submit full license text + weights checksum 2) provide training-data provenance summary 3) run PII scan & attach report 4) export-control self-check 5) request sandbox approval for quant experiments 6) if partner beta -> initiate commercial license discussion or partner-specific agreement. I'll start drafting the sandbox approval template.

sam-ml: Will collect artifacts and post here. Tagging folks: @maya @joe-ops @jordan-product :thumbsup:

triage-bot: Created ticket INFR-1284 for license re-negotiation / sandbox approval tracking (assigned: rebecca-legal, sam-ml).
